ArthasMasteryEternalHungerFrostmourneHun.name: Eternal Hunger
ArthasMasteryEternalHungerFrostmourneHun.description: Quest: Use Frostmourne Hungers on an enemy Hero. Reward: Increases the Mana it restores by 4, to a maximum of 40, and its damage by 4.

ArthasMasteryFrozenWastesFrozenTempest.name: Frozen Wastes
ArthasMasteryFrozenWastesFrozenTempest.description: Frozen Tempest Mana cost reduced by 2 per second. Quest: Damage enemy Heroes with Frozen Tempest. Reward: After damaging enemy Heroes 150 times with Frozen Tempest, the Movement and Attack Speed Slows of Frozen Tempest last an extra 1.5 seconds against enemy Heroes.

ArthasMasteryEmbraceDeathDeathCoil.name: Embrace Death
ArthasMasteryEmbraceDeathDeathCoil.description: Death Coil deals more damage and heals more the lower Arthas's current Health is, to a maximum of 100% bonus damage and healing.

ArthasDeathsAdvance.name: Death's Advance
ArthasDeathsAdvance.description: Increases Movement Speed by 10%. Frozen Tempest's maximum Movement Speed Slow and Attack Speed Slow increased from 40% to 60%

ArthasMasteryFrostPresenceHowlingBlast.name: Frost Presence
ArthasMasteryFrostPresenceHowlingBlast.description: Increase the area of Howling Blast by 20%. Quest: Hit enemy Heroes with Howling Blast. Reward: After Hitting 15 Heroes, Howling Blast's range is increased by 20% and it hits enemies in its path. Reward: After Hitting 30 Heroes, Death Coil Slows Heroes hit by 50% for 1.25 seconds.

ArthasBoreanWinds.name: Borean Winds
ArthasBoreanWinds.description: After Frozen Tempest has been active for 2 seconds, Arthas gains 10% Movement Speed. Passive: Frozen Tempest's Slowing effects last an additional 0.5 seconds and its Mana cost is reduced by 4 per second.

ArthasRime.name: Rime
ArthasRime.description: Every 5 seconds, gain 75 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing the damage taken by 75%. Stores up to 3 charges. Passive: Arthas heals for 24 Health per second while Slowed, Rooted, or Stunned.

ArthasShatteredArmor.name: Shattered Armor
ArthasShatteredArmor.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Howling Blast have their Armor reduced by 15 for 4 seconds.

ArthasIcyTalons.name: Icy Talons
ArthasIcyTalons.description: Gain 3% Attack Speed for 2 seconds every time a Hero is damaged by Frozen Tempest, up to a maximum of 60%.

ArthasMasteryFrostStrikeFrostmourneHunge.name: Frost Strike
ArthasMasteryFrostStrikeFrostmourneHunge.description: Frostmourne Hungers deals an additional 115 Spell Damage in an area and Slows enemy Heroes hit by 20% for 2 seconds.

ArthasMasteryImmortalCoilDeathCoil.name: Immortal Coil
ArthasMasteryImmortalCoilDeathCoil.description: Gain the healing effect of Death Coil even when used on enemies. If Death Coil is used on Arthas, it heals for an additional 75% bonus healing and its cooldown is reduced by 3 seconds.

ArthasRuneTap.name: Rune Tap
ArthasRuneTap.description: Every 3rd Basic Attack heals Arthas for 5% of his max Health. Passive: Each stack of Frostmourne Hungers increases Arthas's maximum Health by 10.

ArthasIceboundFortitude.name: Icebound Fortitude
ArthasIceboundFortitude.description: Activate to instantly remove all Roots and Slows. Gain 25 Armor and reduce the duration of Stuns, Slows, and Roots against Arthas by 75% for 3 seconds. Each Hero Rooted by Howling Blast reduces the cooldown of this ability by 2 seconds.

ArthasHeroicAbilityArmyoftheDead.name: Army of the Dead
ArthasHeroicAbilityArmyoftheDead.description: Consume all charges to summon an equal number of Ghouls that lose Health over 20 seconds and attack for 20 damage. Reactivate to sacrifice a ghoul, healing Arthas for 240 Health. Stores up to 6 charges. Whenever a nearby enemy Minion dies, reduce the charge cooldown of this Abili

ArthasHeroicAbilitySummonSindragosa.name: Summon Sindragosa
ArthasHeroicAbilitySummonSindragosa.description: Deals 230 damage and Slows enemies by 60% for 4 seconds. Also disables Minions, Mercenaries, Monsters and Structures for 20 seconds.

ArthasDeathlord.name: Deathlord
ArthasDeathlord.description: If Death Coil is used on an enemy Hero, launch an additional Death Coil at a nearby enemy Hero. Passive: Death Coil deals more damage the lower Arthas's current Health is, up to a maximum of 50% bonus damage.

ArthasDeathchill.name: Deathchill
ArthasDeathchill.description: Howling Blast's damage is increased by 2 for each stack of Frostmourne Hungers. Howling Blast deals 100% additional damage and Roots for an additional 0.25 seconds against Heroes under 50% Health.

ArthasMasteryBitingColdFrozenTempest.name: Biting Cold
ArthasMasteryBitingColdFrozenTempest.description: Each second an enemy is damaged by Frozen Tempest, it deals 15% bonus damage, up to a 75% bonus.

ArthasMasteryRemorselessWinterFrozenTemp.name: Remorseless Winter
ArthasMasteryRemorselessWinterFrozenTemp.description: Enemy Heroes that remain within Frozen Tempest for 2.5 seconds are Rooted for 1.25 seconds and heal Arthas for 3% of his maximum Health. This effect has an 8 second cooldown per target.

ArthasMasteryFrostmourneFeedsFrostmourne.name: Frostmourne Feeds
ArthasMasteryFrostmourneFeedsFrostmourne.description: Reduce the cooldown of Frostmourne Hungers by 6 seconds. Arthas heals for 75% of the Basic Attack damage dealt by Frostmourne Hungers.

ArthasAntiMagicShell.name: Anti-Magic Shell
ArthasAntiMagicShell.description: Activate to make Arthas immune to Spell Damage for 4 seconds and heal Arthas for 25% of the damage prevented.

ArthasMasteryLegionOfNorthrendArmyoftheD.name: Legion of Northrend
ArthasMasteryLegionOfNorthrendArmyoftheD.description: Reduce Army of the Dead's charge cooldown by 5 seconds. Each charge consumed spawns an additional Ghoul to attack nearby enemies. These Ghouls cannot be sacrificed.

ArthasMasteryAbsoluteZeroSummonSindragos.name: Absolute Zero
ArthasMasteryAbsoluteZeroSummonSindragos.description: Sindragosa flies twice as far. Enemy Heroes are Rooted for 2.5 seconds, and then Slowed by 60% for 4 seconds.

ArthasDeathPact.name: Death Pact
ArthasDeathPact.description: Instantly double your stacks of Frostmourne Hungers, but it no longer gains stacks from hitting Heroes or killing Minions. Passive: Takedowns grant 2 stacks of Frostmourne Hungers.

ArthasPathofFrost.name: Path of Frost
ArthasPathofFrost.description: Activate to instantly mount with 140% minimum Movement Speed. Taking damage does not dismount Arthas from this Mount. Lasts up to 5 seconds. When Arthas dismounts, Slow all nearby enemies by 30% for 2 seconds and deal 66 damage.
